body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: One cropped stone bridge diagonally crosses a small cavern stream. Its thick pier divides a crowded dry storage alcove from a narrow unlit stair for the mage. A low culvert descends into the dungeon. COMPOSITION: Low water-level view from beside the near abutment; timber loft and hanging laundry obscure the upper half. COLOR SCRIPT: frost gray, subdued navy, cold lavender, one small dull red ember. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
